purpose: Test a safe low-latency continuation chain using supported ChatGPT Work GitHub pull-request events while retaining GitHub durable state and authority fencing.
supported_event_evidence: Official OpenAI documentation states eligible Work tasks can respond to GitHub pull-request activity including, depending on trigger, commit updates. Existing connected-app permissions, workspace controls and approval requirements continue to apply to event-triggered tasks.
permission_prior: Current connected GitHub plugin is already demonstrably write-capable in RRuleR. Official docs say event-triggered tasks retain existing app permissions; however action-surface parity for the event worker is still verified by state/EVENT_WORKER_PROBE.json before promotion.

relay_lane.rationale: A dedicated PR branch can emit a supported commit-update event without coupling every main control-state commit to a wake.

rescue_producer.emit_condition: ledger ACTIVE AND program nonterminal AND owner progress stale >=180s AND no outstanding generation
rescue_producer.purpose: Independent bounded producer if the worker fails before emitting its next event.
